question: What mantra formula is assigned to protect the hips at all times?
premises: The hips are named as the protected part
The formula includes śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ, kṛṣṇa, and a ṭha-pair
inference: The mantra formula śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ kṛṣṇa with a ṭha-pair always protects the hips.
uncertainties: Exact mantra structure of ṭhadvayam is technical and not fully explicit.
plain_english: May the mantra śrīṃ-hrīṃ-klīṃ kṛṣṇa with the pair of ṭha syllables always protect my hips.
